name: Air-cushioned sole
summary: A thick rubber sole with sealed air pockets in the heel and the forefoot, which soften the impact of each step.
how: Mould the sole with sealed pockets of air.
Join the sole to the welted upper with a heat seal and a stitch.
Make the sole 3 to 4 cm thick.

origin.note: Klaus Märtens founds a company on the patent of his air-cushioned sole.

adoptions.via: A Northamptonshire factory fits the air-cushioned sole to the eight-eye boot.
